observed_causes: ChatGPT window actively requested idle inhibition while global Stay Awake was off.
Changing IdleMonitor respectInhibitors at runtime left its QML idle state stale even after a native idle event.

workaround.kind: user-owned clone of omarchy.idle, no packaged file edits
workaround.policy: Ignore only ChatGPT when it is the sole reported window inhibitor; respect other reported windows, static/dynamic noidle tags, explicit stay-awake and failed probes.
workaround.monitor_modes: Separate fixed true/false respectInhibitors monitors; select effective state at QML level.

limitations: One natural idle/screensaver/lock cycle observed; reboot persistence not yet observed.
Other-window inhibitor/noidle cases were verified in model controls, not a live video playback test.
Compositor clients identify window-associated inhibitors; anonymous/non-window attribution is unavailable through this query.
A user-owned service clone does not automatically incorporate later packaged idle-service updates.
